results.title: Marshall Stanmore III speaker with turntable connectivity and brass knobs drops to lowest price on Amazon
results.description: Deal | The Marshall Stanmore III Bluetooth speaker is on sale at Amazon at 50% off the MSRP. It delivers powerful sound for podcasts and music using dual 15-watt drivers and a 50-watt woofer. The speaker can be connected directly to turntables using RCA connectors.
